import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_5.csv')
g = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost']
stats = g.agg(['mean','median','std','max','count'])
# z-score within group using median/MAD for robustness
def spike(row): pass
df['med'] = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost'].transform('median')
df['mad'] = df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName'])['BilledCost'].transform(lambda s: (s - s.median()).abs().median())
df['z'] = 0.6745*(df['BilledCost']-df['med'])/(df['mad']+1e-9)
top = df.sort_values('z', ascending=False).head(10)
print(top[['ChargePeriodStart','SubAccountName','ServiceName','BilledCost','med','z']])
